subject.title: fix(config): reject zero heartbeat every interval in Zod schema

question: Should OpenClaw keep supporting `heartbeat.every: "0m"` as the documented heartbeat-disable sentinel, or intentionally remove it with a migration/docs plan?
rationale: The current source, tests, and docs make zero durations a shipped config contract, so changing validation needs explicit product direction rather than a narrow bug-fix merge.

options.title: Keep the disable sentinel
options.body: Keep `0m` and equivalent zero durations valid as the heartbeat-disable path, and reject this stricter validation shape.

options.title: Deprecate zero with migration
options.body: If maintainers want zero durations invalid, require updated docs, doctor/migration behavior, and upgrade proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Keep the disable sentinel
recommendation.body: Keep `0m` and equivalent zero durations valid as the heartbeat-disable path, and reject this stricter validation shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest history across heartbeat configuration and update/restart behavior touched by this PR.
